claim_ceiling: Synthetic campaign plan only. No compression, streaming, storage or retention implementation is qualified.

scenarios.name: Continuous lossless archival baseline
scenarios.conditions: Exact raw source chunks and acquisition configuration are available with a frozen expected byte digest.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Archive and retrieve chunks; verify byte identity and deterministic replay.

scenarios.name: Lossless compression and decompression
scenarios.conditions: Compression/decompression are versioned and no lossy transform is applied.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Verify exact source byte equality after round trip.

scenarios.name: Lossy compression attenuates a rare transient
scenarios.conditions: A rare impulsive event is attenuated below the frozen detection threshold after compression.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Fail non-inferiority; preserve source and record the lost event signature.

scenarios.name: Lossy compression stays inside the declared envelope
scenarios.conditions: Held-out events and no-event periods are available with independent truth and distortion budget.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Accept only if all pre-registered detection/localization/uncertainty guardrails hold.

scenarios.name: Downsampling aliases an event waveform
scenarios.conditions: Sampling reduction violates the declared signal bandwidth/Nyquist condition for the target event.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Reject and retain original high-rate source.

scenarios.name: High-rate pre/post event buffer is complete
scenarios.conditions: Event trigger fires under declared load with sufficient pre-trigger buffer and post-trigger duration.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Verify expected sample counts, timestamps, source digest and no gap.

scenarios.name: Trigger burst overruns ring buffer
scenarios.conditions: Burst rate exceeds memory/buffer budget and overwrites oldest context.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Expose overflow, incomplete pre/post window and lost duration; never silently accept.

scenarios.name: Low-rate screen misses a short event
scenarios.conditions: A short critical transient falls between low-rate samples and no high-rate trigger is raised.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Count critical miss; low-rate negative cannot clear the event.

scenarios.name: Noisy environment causes repeated triggers
scenarios.conditions: Repeated triggers merge under declared rules without losing raw context or exhausting resources.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Report false-trigger rate, retained bytes and resource impact.

scenarios.name: Link outage during acquisition
scenarios.conditions: Source acquisition continues locally but remote storage is unavailable.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Record outage interval, local buffer state, completeness and recovery lag.

scenarios.name: Edge processor falls behind source rate
scenarios.conditions: Processing queue age grows beyond declared limit.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Expose queue lag and skipped/late decisions; do not claim real-time coverage.

scenarios.name: Stored source bytes do not match acquired digest
scenarios.conditions: A chunk is truncated or modified during transfer/storage.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Reject exact-source claim and prevent downstream evidence acceptance.

scenarios.name: Derived feature lacks a resolvable parent artifact
scenarios.conditions: Feature references a missing or wrong source digest.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Reject provenance chain; do not present as reproducible evidence.

scenarios.name: Chunk timestamps contain a gap or clock jump
scenarios.conditions: Timebase changes or chunks are missing; sample sequence alone appears continuous.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Preserve the gap and invalidate event-latency/periodicity claims across it.

scenarios.name: Edge detector encounters out-of-distribution coupling
scenarios.conditions: A new conduit/coupling profile has no qualified model support.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Abstain or escalate; do not use feature absence as no-event proof.

scenarios.name: Archive tier migration and integrity verification
scenarios.conditions: An object migrates between storage tiers with exact object version and digest receipt.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Verify byte equality, metadata and retrieval after migration.

scenarios.name: Unauthorized consumer requests restricted waveform
scenarios.conditions: Consumer role lacks owner permission for the source/route purpose.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Deny access and preserve auditable access decision.

scenarios.name: Owner-approved retention expiry
scenarios.conditions: Retention duration elapses for a scoped artifact and no legal hold applies.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Delete or cryptographically expire according to approved policy while preserving permitted audit receipt.

scenarios.name: Missing samples incorrectly represented as no event
scenarios.conditions: Data outage or blind interval is encoded as a clean negative result.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Reject negative claim and preserve missingness state.

scenarios.name: Expensive query overloads observation service
scenarios.conditions: Unbounded time/spatial query or repeated subscription exhausts resources.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Enforce query quotas/complexity controls, rate limits and bounded streaming.

scenarios.name: Feature-only archive requested for raw replay task
scenarios.conditions: Only embeddings/features remain; original waveform was not retained.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Return Unsupported for raw replay and disclose retention limitation.

scenarios.name: Normalization drops vendor gauge length or timebase config
scenarios.conditions: Normalized stream omits source-specific acquisition fields needed for matched replay.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Reject normalization or preserve missing metadata as unqualified.

scenarios.name: Compression settings drift after firmware update
scenarios.conditions: Vendor firmware changes quantization/encoding behavior without profile revision.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Require new source profile and repeat qualification.

scenarios.name: Exact source and transform revisions reproduce identical result
scenarios.conditions: All immutable source objects and transform software/config hashes are present.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Independent replay yields identical deterministic outputs or declared numeric tolerance.

global_controls: Original source bytes are immutable when available and rights permit.
Lossy transformations create a separate derived artifact and never overwrite source bytes.
Every derived artifact binds exact parent digest, method, parameters and software revision.
Missing or unobserved samples are not negative observations.
High-rate buffer overflow and dropped samples are explicit dispositions.
Compression acceptance requires event, localization, uncertainty and replay guardrails.
Data rights and retention policies apply independently to source and derived artifacts.
Operational observation pipeline is read-only relative to SCADA/protection.
Cost is compared only within declared compatible units.
All test populations and source acquisition profiles remain separate.
